notes: Supplier quotations (PR_QUOT_MAST / PR_QUOT_DET under PR_REQ_MAST; unused): price-line checks, reply / accept flags, one accepted supplier, header discount and arrival dates, REQ_STATUS 1-3 (APP_RULES_SA); lowest-price, create / delete PO buttons not reproduced Wave 3b: supplier lists; each price line shows its item and requested quantity (read through REQ_DET_SERIAL).

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.QUOT_TRNS_TYPE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 13 AND T.QUOT_TRNS_TYPE IS NOT NULL) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE NVL(TP.FLAG,0) = 1 AND TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (TRNS_TYPE_CODE, TRNS_SERIAL) IN (SELECT Q.TRNS_TYPE_CODE, Q.TRNS_SERIAL FROM PR_QUOT_MAST Q)

PR_QUOT_MAST.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where nvl(stopflag, 0) = 0 order by code

PR_QUOT_DET.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where nvl(stopflag, 0) = 0 order by code

PR_QUOT_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(r.item_code || ' - ' || (select nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e) from st_item i where i.item_code = r.item_code and i.item_group_code = r.item_group_code)) from pr_req_det r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial and r.req_det_serial = t.req_det_serial)

PR_QUOT_DET.RFQ_QUANTITY.sql: (select max(r.quantity) from pr_req_det r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial and r.req_det_serial = t.req_det_serial)

params.name: SUPPLIER
params.lov_sql: select q.supplier_id || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, q.supplier_id r from pr_quot_mast q, supplier s, pr_req_mast m where s.code = q.supplier_id and m.rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID) and q.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and q.trns_serial = m.trns_serial and nvl(q.accept_flag, 0) = 1 order by q.supplier_id
